summary: Jade Empire entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Jade Empire
entries.definitive_edition: Jade Empire: Special Edition on Windows PC

emulation.emulator: Not required; Xemu only for original Xbox comparison
emulation.notes: Use native PC Special Edition for primary.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Current PC Special Edition with documented fixes

primary.why: The PC Special Edition is the expanded route, adding extra content over the original Xbox release while giving the best capture/settings path. The original Xbox version remains useful for launch-version comparison.
primary.how_to_play: Use the Steam or GOG Special Edition. Record storefront/build, compatibility fixes, resolution, controller/mouse settings, difficulty, martial style progression, bonus content state, and whether original Xbox behavior was compared.

secondary.what_to_play: Use only for original console comparison.
secondary.why: Special Edition is the expanded and higher-fidelity route.
PC Special Edition is the best main archive route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record known fixes and controller/input behavior; old PC releases may need compatibility work.
